# Moderation

## GET `/api/v1/review-queue/posts`
List post revisions awaiting editorial or Admin moderation review
- operationId: `listPostReviewQueue`
- Params: `query:page (integer)`, `query:limit (integer)`, `query:status (string)`, `query:type (string)`, `query:priority (string)`
- Request: —
- Responses: `200` → ReviewQueueListResponse, `400` → ErrorResponse, `401` → ErrorResponse, `403` → ErrorResponse

## PATCH `/api/v1/review-queue/posts/{id}/approve`
Approve latest post revision
- operationId: `approvePostReview`

- Request: `object` (required)
- Responses: `200` → ReviewQueueItemResponse, `400` → ErrorResponse, `401` → ErrorResponse, `403` → ErrorResponse, `404` → ErrorResponse, `409` → ErrorResponse, `423` → ErrorResponse

